name: FedMedICL
description: For medical imaging AI models to be clinically impactful, they must generalize. However, this goal is hindered by (i) diverse types of distribution shifts, such as temporal, demographic, and label shifts, and (ii) limited diversity in datasets that are siloed within single medical institutions. While these limitations have spurred interest in federated learning, current evaluation benchmarks fail to evaluate different shifts simultaneously. However, in real healthcare settings, multiple types of shifts co-exist, yet their impact on medical imaging performance remains unstudied.
